1	# webERP Z_Import* utilities and StockCounts: CSV bulk-import pages and the stock-count entry page
2	
3	Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	This topic holds webERP's one-off CSV import pages (chart of accounts, GL account groups and sections, GL transactions, fixed assets, part codes, price list, stock items, suppliers) and `StockCounts.php`. Each import page takes an uploaded CSV, validates it and writes to the database, either in one transaction or row by row through an API function. They call `GetNextTransNo` and `GetPeriod` (in includes), `InsertGLAccountGroup`, `InsertGLAccountSection`, `InsertStockItem`, and `includes/GLPostings.php`.
6	
7	## Contract
8	**In (all pages):** HTTP form posts with an uploaded CSV (comma-separated, header row first), plus a `gettemplate` GET flag on some pages.
9	
10	| Page | Upload field | Other inputs | Header (case-insensitive match) |
11	|---|---|---|---|
12	| `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php` | `ChartFile` | – | Account Code, Description, Account Group (3) |
13	| `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php` | `SelectedAssetFile` | `DateToEnter`, `FromUserID`, `ToUserID` | Description, LongDescription, AssetCategoryID, SerialNo, BarCode, AssetLocationCode, Cost, AccumDepn, DepnType, DepnRate, DatePurchased (11) |
14	| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountGroups.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
15	| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountSections.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
16	| `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php` | `userfile` | `TransactionType`, `Currency` | Date, Account, ChequeNo, Amount, Narrative, Tag (6) |
17	| `webERP/Z_ImportPartCodes.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
18	| `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php` | `PriceListFile` | `StartDate` | StockID, SalesType, CurrencyCode, Price (4) |
19	| `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php` | `userfile` | – | StockID, Description, LongDescription, CategoryID, Units, MBFlag, EOQ, Discontinued, Controlled, Serialised, Perishable, Volume, grossweight, BarCode, DiscountCategory, TaxCat, DecimalPlaces, ItemPDF (18) |
20	| `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php` | `userfile` | `UpdateIfExists` (0/1) | SupplierID, SuppName, Address1-6, Phone, Fax, Email, SupplierType, CurrCode, SupplierSince, PaymentTerms, BankPartics, BankRef, BankAct, Remittance, TaxGroup, FactorID, latitude, longitude, TaxRef |
21	
22	**Out:** DB writes and `prnMsg` or HTML output.
23	
24	| Page | Tables written | How |
25	|---|---|---|
26	| Chart of accounts | `chartmaster` (accountcode, accountname, group_) | One transaction, then `includes/GLPostings.php` |
27	| Fixed assets | `fixedassets`, `fixedassettrans` | `fixedassettrans` gets two rows per asset, types `cost` and `depn` |
28	| GL transactions | `gltrans`, `banktrans` | One transaction |
29	| Price list | `prices` | UPDATE closes open prices, then INSERT |
30	| Stocks | `stockmaster`, `locstock` | `locstock` is INSERT…SELECT from `locations` |
31	| Suppliers | `suppliers` | INSERT or UPDATE |
32	| GL account groups, GL account sections, part codes | – | Through `InsertGLAccountGroup($AccountGroupDetails,'','')`, `InsertGLAccountSection($AccountSectionDetails,'','')` and `InsertStockItem($ItemDetails,'','')`. A return of `$Answer[0]==0` means success (behaviour not in this topic) |
33	
34	`webERP/StockCounts.php`: GET/POST `Action` ('View' or 'Enter'), GET `gettemplate`, and `$_SESSION['FormID']` in the form. The template CSV header is StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference.
35	
36	## Entry points and guards (in order)
37	No page shows a permission check.
38	
39	**Chart of accounts**
40	- `if isset($_FILES['ChartFile']) and name` -> process the file; otherwise show the form.
41	- `if count($HeadRow) != 3` -> error, fclose, exit.
42	- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
43	- `if count($MyRow) != 3` -> error, exit.
44	- `if COUNT(groupname) in accountgroups == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
45	- `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT into chartmaster.
46	- `if $InputError==1` -> break.
47	
48	**Fixed assets**
49	- `if isset($_FILES['SelectedAssetFile']['name'])` -> process the file.
50	- `elseif gettemplate` -> output the CSV header.
51	- Otherwise show the upload form with a date selector.
52	- `if count($HeaderRow) != count($FieldNames)` -> error, exit.
53	- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
54	- `if row field count != 11` -> error, exit.
55	- Per-row checks that set `$InputError=true`; none of them stops the loop, so all errors are collected:
56	  - `strlen(Description)==0 or >50`
57	  - `!is_numeric(DepnRate)`
58	  - `DepnRate<0 or >100`
59	  - `!is_numeric(AccumDepn)`
60	  - `AccumDepn<0`
61	  - `!is_numeric(Cost)`
62	  - `Cost<=0`
63	  - `DepnType !='SL' AND !='DV'`
64	  - `fixedassetcategories` has no row for the category
65	  - `fixedassetlocations` has no row for the location
66	  - `!Is_Date(DatePurchased)`
67	- `DepnType` 'DV' becomes 1, otherwise 0.
68	- `if FromUserID==ToUserID` -> error, `$InputError=1`.
69	- `if $InputError == false` -> `GetNextTransNo(49)`, `GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate(DateToEnter))`, INSERT `fixedassets`.
70	  - If `DB_error_no()==0`: `DB_Last_Insert_ID('fixedassets','assetid')`, then two `fixedassettrans` INSERTs (`cost` and `depn`), then a success message.
71	
72	**GL account groups and sections**
73	- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form (the sections page also shows an info message).
74	- `if $FieldValues[0]!=''` -> build the array and call the Insert function.
75	- Groups page: `if $Answer[0]==0` -> success and `$successes++`; otherwise failure, list errors, `$failures++`.
76	- Sections page: same, with `$ErrorDescription` giving the error text.
77	
78	**GL transactions**
79	- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
80	- If the first cell starts with the BOM `\xef\xbb\xbf`, strip it.
81	- `if count($HeadRow) != 6` -> error, exit.
82	- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
83	- `GetNextTransNo($_POST['TransactionType'])`.
84	- SELECT the currency rate for `$_POST['Currency']`.
85	- `DB_Txn_Begin()`.
86	- Per row:
87	  - `if field count != target` -> error, exit.
88	  - `if COUNT(accountcode) in chartmaster == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
89	  - `if !Is_date(row[0])` -> `$InputError=1`.
90	  - `GetPeriod(row[0])`.
91	  - `if isset($PreviousPeriod) and $PreviousPeriod != $Period` -> `$InputError=1`.
92	  - Amount is cast to float.
93	  - `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT `gltrans`.
94	  - `if TransactionType != 0 AND IsBankAccount(row[1])` -> read the rate from currencies joined to bankaccounts, INSERT `banktrans` (banktranstype `__('Cheque')`).
95	  - Add the amount to `$TransactionTotal`.
96	  - `if $InputError==1` -> break.
97	- After the loop: `if $InputError != 1 and round($TransactionTotal,2) != 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
98	- Then rollback if `$InputError==1`, otherwise commit.
99	
100	**Part codes**
101	- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form.
102	- `if DB_num_rows(select * from locations)==0` -> error "No locations have been set up...".
103	- Per row: `if $FieldValues[0] != ''` -> map to `$ItemDetails`, call `InsertStockItem`.
104	  - `$Answer[0]==0` -> success row.
105	  - Otherwise failure row listing the errors.
106	- No transaction wraps the loop.
107	
108	**Price list**
109	- `if $_FILES['PriceListFile']['name']` is set and non-empty -> process.
110	- BOM, header count != 4, and header name mismatch each give an error and exit.
111	- Data row field count != 4 -> error, exit.
112	- Per row: StockID not in `stockmaster`, SalesType not in `salestypes` (typeabbrev), or CurrencyCode not in `currencies` (currabrev) -> `InputError=1`.
113	- `if InputError==1` -> break and rollback.
114	- Otherwise commit.
115	
116	**Stocks**
117	- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']['name'])` -> process.
118	- `elseif gettemplate` -> template download.
119	- Otherwise show the form.
120	- Header count != 18 or name mismatch -> error, exit.
121	- Row field count != 18 -> error, exit.
122	- Per-row checks, each setting `$InputError=1`:
123	  - StockID already in `stockmaster`.
124	  - Description empty or >50.
125	  - LongDescription empty.
126	  - StockID empty.
127	  - `ContainsIllegalCharacters(StockID)` or contains a space (StockID is then blanked).
128	  - Units >20 chars.
129	  - Barcode >20 chars.
130	  - `Perishable != 0 and != 1`.
131	  - Volume not numeric, or <0.
132	  - Weight not numeric, or <0.
133	  - EOQ not numeric, or <0.
134	  - `Controlled==0 AND Serialised==1`.
135	  - MBFlag not one of M, K, A, B, D, G.
136	  - MBFlag in A, K, D, G with `Controlled==1`.
137	  - CategoryID empty.
138	  - ItemPDF empty.
139	- `if $InputError != 1 AND Serialised==1` -> DecimalPlaces set to 0.
140	- `DB_Txn_Begin()`, INSERT `stockmaster`.
141	- `if DB_error_no()==0` -> INSERT `locstock`; otherwise `$InputError=1`, print the error, break.
142	- Rollback if `$InputError==1`, otherwise commit.
143	
144	**Suppliers**
145	- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
146	- `elseif gettemplate` -> CSV header only.
147	- Header count mismatch and header name mismatch give an error and exit.
148	- Row field count != `$FieldTarget` -> error, exit.
149	- Per-row checks, each setting `$InputError=1`:
150	  - SuppName length 0 or >40.
151	  - SupplierID empty.
152	  - `ContainsIllegalCharacters(SupplierID)`.
153	  - Phone >25.
154	  - Fax >25.
155	  - Email >55.
156	  - Email non-empty and `!IsEmailAddress`.
157	  - BankRef >12.
158	  - `!Is_Date(SupplierSince)`.
159	- `if $InputError != 1` -> `SELECT COUNT(supplierid)`; `>0` sets `$SuppExists`.
160	- `SuppExists AND UpdateIfExists != 1` -> `$UpdatedNum++`, no update.
161	- `SuppExists AND UpdateIfExists == 1` -> `$UpdatedNum++`, UPDATE suppliers.
162	  - `currcode` is only updated if `supptrans` has no rows for the supplier (`$SuppTrans==0`).
163	  - If the old currency differs from `$_POST['CurrCode']`, an info message says it cannot change currency.
164	- `!SuppExists` -> `$InsertNum++`, INSERT.
165	- `InputError==1` -> break and rollback; otherwise commit with the counts.
166	
167	**StockCounts.php**
168	- If neither POST nor GET `Action` is set -> 'Enter'.
169	- If POST `Action` is set -> it overwrites GET.
170	- If GET `Action` is not 'View' or 'Enter' -> 'Enter'.
171	- If `gettemplate` is set, the page sends these headers:
172	  - Content-Type: application/force-download, application/octet-stream, application/download
173	  - Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=ImportTemplate.csv
174	  - Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
175	- It then calls `ob_clean()`, outputs the header row, includes the footer and exits.
176	- Otherwise it calls `ob_end_flush()`.
177	- The source ends at an incomplete `if ($_GET['Action']=='Enter')`, so no Enter or View logic is shown.
178	
179	## Decisions
180	- Every transactional importer uses `$InputError==1` to choose rollback over commit. These are chart of accounts, fixed assets, GL transactions, price list, stocks and suppliers.
181	- Failure messages: "Failed on row N. Batch import … rolled back" (chart of accounts, fixed assets, suppliers, GL transactions).
182	- Part codes, GL groups and GL sections process each row independently. A failed row does not stop later rows, and there is no rollback.
183	- The Insert APIs apply their own validation (behaviour not in this topic).
184	- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` with `UpdateIfExists != 1` counts existing suppliers as "Exist" and does not write them.
185	- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` validates `$_POST['SuppName']`, `Phone` and similar, not the CSV row values (the condensation lists `$_POST` names; how row values map to them is not shown).
186	
187	## Order and failure
188	- A header or field-count error does `fclose` and `exit`.
189	  - Chart of accounts, GL transactions and stocks: this happens inside an open transaction or before commit. The condensations show no rollback call on that path (GL transactions notes the transaction is left open).
190	  - Fixed assets, price list and suppliers: whether the exit comes before or after `DB_Txn_Begin()` is not shown.
191	- GL transactions calls `GetNextTransNo` before `DB_Txn_Begin()`. Inside it:
192	  - SELECT … FOR UPDATE on `systypes`
193	  - UPDATE `typeno=typeno+1`
194	  - SELECT of the new `typeno`
195	- That increment is not in the import's transaction, so a rolled-back import still consumes a number.
196	- Fixed assets calls `GetNextTransNo(49)` and `GetPeriod` per valid asset (inside the transaction).
197	- `GetNextTransNo` errors are CRITICAL ERROR messages through `DB_query`'s `$ErrMsg`.
198	- `GetPeriod($TransDate,$UseProhibit=true)`:
199	  - It parses the date by separator `/`, `-` or `.`, and by `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']`.
200	  - If `ProhibitPostingsBefore` is a valid date, earlier dates are moved up to it.
201	  - If `periods` is empty, it inserts periods 0 and 1.
202	  - If the date has no period (`!PeriodExists`), it creates missing periods with `CreatePeriod` after the last period or before the first, and then returns the period number.
203	  - So importing dates far out creates `periods` rows.
204	- The `GetPeriod` body past line 1338 was not read.
205	- In the GL transactions import, `gltrans` rows are skipped once `$InputError` is set, but the rollback undoes earlier inserts.
206	- The chart of accounts import ends with `fclose` and `include('includes/GLPostings.php')` (behaviour not in this topic). That include is reported as "bug: file not found" in a comment.
207	- No page handles `fopen` or `fgetcsv` failure.
208	
209	## Connections
210	- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` `GetNextTransNo($TransType)`: returns the incremented `systypes.typeno`. Called by the GL transactions import (type from `$_POST['TransactionType']`) and the fixed assets import (type 49).
211	- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` `GetPeriod`: returns the period number. Called by the GL transactions import and the fixed assets import.
212	- Tables read: `accountgroups`, `fixedassetcategories`, `fixedassetlocations`, `chartmaster`, `currencies`, `bankaccounts`, `stockmaster`, `salestypes`, `locations`, `supptrans`, `suppliers`.
213	- Tables written: see the Contract table.
214	- `$_SESSION['FormID']` is embedded in forms.
215	- `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']` and `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are read by `GetPeriod` and the date checks.
216	- The part-code, group and section pages hand rows to the Insert API functions.
217	
218	## Conclusions
219	- No page checks a permission, so any user who can reach it can bulk-write accounts, assets, prices, stock and suppliers.
220	- `MAX_FILE_SIZE=1000000` is only a hidden form field, and no PHP code checks it.
221	- Price list: there is no duplicate check, and `UPDATE prices` closes open prices for the matching stockid and typeabbrev, so the old rows get `enddate=StartDate`. A row whose stock id exists but whose price is empty is inserted with price 0.
222	- Importing the same chart of accounts file twice: the second INSERT depends on the schema's key and may fail, which rolls the batch back; no pre-check exists. Stocks reject existing StockIDs, so a second run fails with "already exists". Suppliers re-run is idempotent when `UpdateIfExists` is 0 and refreshes the data when it is 1. Part codes, groups and sections depend on the Insert functions.
223	- GL transactions: all rows must fall in one period (`PreviousPeriod != Period` -> error) and must sum to zero after rounding to 2 decimals. Note that `GetPeriod` may move prohibited-period dates forward, so dates before `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are accepted and mapped to the same period. For TransactionType 0, no `banktrans` rows are written. For non-zero types, only rows whose account is a bank account write `banktrans`.
224	- Fixed assets: `DepnType` is stored as 1 for DV and 0 for SL. One asset gets two `fixedassettrans` rows. The "FromUserID == ToUserID" check does not relate to any CSV field and rejects the batch, so it depends on form fields not described. A bad row does not stop validation, so the rollback message appears only after the whole file has been checked.
225	- Fixed asset error text says "more than 3 characters" while the code checks only `strlen==0` or `>50`.
226	- Stocks: the `locstock` rows are created for every location. `ItemPDF` has to hold a filename or `none`. Stocks does not check that `CategoryID`, `TaxCat` or `MBFlag` references exist beyond the checks listed.
227	- Suppliers does not check that `CurrCode`, `SupplierType`, `PaymentTerms`, `TaxGroup` or `FactorID` exist.
228	- Suppliers does not check latitude or longitude.
229	- `StockCounts.php` has no live Enter or View body in the source shown, so nothing about saving counts follows from it. Its import template is only a download; no importer reading `StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference` is in this topic.
230	- No sender of these forms was found other than the pages' own forms. The part-code and GL pages hand rows to the Insert API functions, whose acceptance of the array keys (taken from the CSV headers) is not checked here.
231	
232	## Hazards
233	- Rows are inserted with unescaped CSV values in SQL (no injection protection shown).
234	- Part codes, groups and sections are partially applied after failures, because there is no rollback.
235	- Error exits for column errors during open transactions can leave them open (GL transactions explicitly).
236	- A rolled-back GL import or fixed asset import still increments `systypes.typeno`.
237	- `GetPeriod` creates `periods` rows as a side effect for far-off dates.
238	- The price list import can create several active prices for one stock, sales type and currency.
239	- The supplier page's `UpdateIfExists` update path can silently leave `currcode` unchanged.
240	
241	## Open first
242	- `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php`: the most complex flow (period, balance, bank transactions).
243	- `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php`: the longest validation list.
244	- `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php`: insert/update logic.
245	- `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php`: validation and asset records.
246	- `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php`, `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php`: transactional imports.
247	- `webERP/StockCounts.php`: template download.
248	
249	## Connected topics
250	
251	Topics this one exchanges work or records with, wherever they sit in the map (paths from the export's root):
252	
253	- [webERP commission calculation, date/period utilities, GL account lookup helpers…](weberp-accounts-receivable-accounts-payable-bank-and-gl-post-152/weberp-commission-calculation-date-period-utilities-gl-accou-57/brief.md)
254	  - this topic took from `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php`: `GetPeriod` parses the date, applies `ProhibitPostingsBefore`, inserts first periods if none exist, and creates missing periods via `CreatePeriod`; `PeriodExists` checks `periods`.
255	  - this topic took from `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`: `GetNextTransNo` does SELECT typeno FROM systypes FOR UPDATE, UPDATE typeno=typeno+1, SELECT typeno, returns it, with CRITICAL ERROR messages.

## Decisions
- Every transactional importer uses `$InputError==1` to choose rollback over commit. These are chart of accounts, fixed assets, GL transactions, price list, stocks and suppliers.
- Failure messages: "Failed on row N. Batch import … rolled back" (chart of accounts, fixed assets, suppliers, GL transactions).
- Part codes, GL groups and GL sections process each row independently. A failed row does not stop later rows, and there is no rollback.
- The Insert APIs apply their own validation (behaviour not in this topic).
- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` with `UpdateIfExists != 1` counts existing suppliers as "Exist" and does not write them.
- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` validates `$_POST['SuppName']`, `Phone` and similar, not the CSV row values (the condensation lists `$_POST` names; how row values map to them is not shown).

## Order and failure
- A header or field-count error does `fclose` and `exit`.
  - Chart of accounts, GL transactions and stocks: this happens inside an open transaction or before commit. The condensations show no rollback call on that path (GL transactions notes the transaction is left open).
  - Fixed assets, price list and suppliers: whether the exit comes before or after `DB_Txn_Begin()` is not shown.
- GL transactions calls `GetNextTransNo` before `DB_Txn_Begin()`. Inside it:
  - SELECT … FOR UPDATE on `systypes`
  - UPDATE `typeno=typeno+1`
  - SELECT of the new `typeno`
- That increment is not in the import's transaction, so a rolled-back import still consumes a number.
- Fixed assets calls `GetNextTransNo(49)` and `GetPeriod` per valid asset (inside the transaction).
- `GetNextTransNo` errors are CRITICAL ERROR messages through `DB_query`'s `$ErrMsg`.
- `GetPeriod($TransDate,$UseProhibit=true)`:
  - It parses the date by separator `/`, `-` or `.`, and by `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']`.
  - If `ProhibitPostingsBefore` is a valid date, earlier dates are moved up to it.
  - If `periods` is empty, it inserts periods 0 and 1.
  - If the date has no period (`!PeriodExists`), it creates missing periods with `CreatePeriod` after the last period or before the first, and then returns the period number.
  - So importing dates far out creates `periods` rows.
- The `GetPeriod` body past line 1338 was not read.
- In the GL transactions import, `gltrans` rows are skipped once `$InputError` is set, but the rollback undoes earlier inserts.
- The chart of accounts import ends with `fclose` and `include('includes/GLPostings.php')` (behaviour not in this topic). That include is reported as "bug: file not found" in a comment.
- No page handles `fopen` or `fgetcsv` failure.

- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` `GetNextTransNo($TransType)`: returns the incremented `systypes.typeno`. Called by the GL transactions import (type from `$_POST['TransactionType']`) and the fixed assets import (type 49).

- The part-code, group and section pages hand rows to the Insert API functions.

## Conclusions
- No page checks a permission, so any user who can reach it can bulk-write accounts, assets, prices, stock and suppliers.
- `MAX_FILE_SIZE=1000000` is only a hidden form field, and no PHP code checks it.
- Price list: there is no duplicate check, and `UPDATE prices` closes open prices for the matching stockid and typeabbrev, so the old rows get `enddate=StartDate`. A row whose stock id exists but whose price is empty is inserted with price 0.
- Importing the same chart of accounts file twice: the second INSERT depends on the schema's key and may fail, which rolls the batch back; no pre-check exists. Stocks reject existing StockIDs, so a second run fails with "already exists". Suppliers re-run is idempotent when `UpdateIfExists` is 0 and refreshes the data when it is 1. Part codes, groups and sections depend on the Insert functions.
- GL transactions: all rows must fall in one period (`PreviousPeriod != Period` -> error) and must sum to zero after rounding to 2 decimals. Note that `GetPeriod` may move prohibited-period dates forward, so dates before `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are accepted and mapped to the same period. For TransactionType 0, no `banktrans` rows are written. For non-zero types, only rows whose account is a bank account write `banktrans`.
- Fixed assets: `DepnType` is stored as 1 for DV and 0 for SL. One asset gets two `fixedassettrans` rows. The "FromUserID == ToUserID" check does not relate to any CSV field and rejects the batch, so it depends on form fields not described. A bad row does not stop validation, so the rollback message appears only after the whole file has been checked.
- Fixed asset error text says "more than 3 characters" while the code checks only `strlen==0` or `>50`.
- Stocks: the `locstock` rows are created for every location. `ItemPDF` has to hold a filename or `none`. Stocks does not check that `CategoryID`, `TaxCat` or `MBFlag` references exist beyond the checks listed.
- Suppliers does not check that `CurrCode`, `SupplierType`, `PaymentTerms`, `TaxGroup` or `FactorID` exist.
- Suppliers does not check latitude or longitude.
- `StockCounts.php` has no live Enter or View body in the source shown, so nothing about saving counts follows from it. Its import template is only a download; no importer reading `StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference` is in this topic.
- No sender of these forms was found other than the pages' own forms. The part-code and GL pages hand rows to the Insert API functions, whose acceptance of the array keys (taken from the CSV headers) is not checked here.

## Hazards
- Rows are inserted with unescaped CSV values in SQL (no injection protection shown).
- Part codes, groups and sections are partially applied after failures, because there is no rollback.
- Error exits for column errors during open transactions can leave them open (GL transactions explicitly).
- A rolled-back GL import or fixed asset import still increments `systypes.typeno`.
- `GetPeriod` creates `periods` rows as a side effect for far-off dates.
- The price list import can create several active prices for one stock, sales type and currency.
- The supplier page's `UpdateIfExists` update path can silently leave `currcode` unchanged.

180	- **Update:** everything is inside one transaction. Errors from `DB_query` are re-raised to the caller. No explicit rollback is shown, and `DB_Txn_Commit` follows the later steps.

# webERP stock item maintenance: Stocks.php plus the Z_ChangeStockCategory.php and Z_ChangeStockCode.php utilities

Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Stocks.php is the item create, update and delete page, with navigation, multilingual descriptions, category properties and image upload. The two Z_ utilities rename a stock category code or an item code across the related tables. All of it reads and writes `stockmaster` and the tables around it directly, and it takes transaction numbers from `GetNextTransNo`.

## Contract
- **In:**
  - POST/GET form fields: `StockID` (trimmed, uppercased), `NextItem`, `PreviousItem`, `UpdateCategories`, `New`, `submit`, `delete`, `ClearImage`, `ItemPicture` (file).
  - Item fields: `Description`, `LongDescription`, `Units`, `BarCode`, `Volume`, `GrossWeight`, `NetWeight`, `EOQ`, `Controlled`, `Serialised`, `Perishable`, `NextSerialNo`, `MBFlag`, `CategoryID`, `Pansize`, `ShrinkFactor`, `Discontinued`, `DiscountCategory`, `TaxCat`, `DecimalPlaces`.
  - Language fields: `Description_<LanguageId>`, `LongDescription_<LanguageId>`.
  - Property fields: `PropertyCounter`, `PropID<i>`, `PropNumeric<i>`, `PropType<i>`, `PropValue<i>`, `PropMin<i>`, `PropMax<i>`.
  - Z_ChangeStockCategory.php: `ProcessStockChange`, `OldStockCategory`, `NewStockCategory`.
  - Z_ChangeStockCode.php: `OldStockID`, `NewStockID` (uppercased).
  - Session values: `ItemDescriptionLanguages` (comma-separated), `MaxImageSize` (KB), `part_pics_dir`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']`, `DefaultDateFormat`, `DefaultTaxCategory`, `SelectedStockItem`.
- **Out, written tables:**
  - `stockmaster`
  - `stockdescriptiontranslations`
  - `stockitemproperties`
  - `locstock`
  - `gltrans` (type 0 journals)
  - `stockcategory`
  - `stockcatproperties`
  - `salesanalysis`
  - `internalstockcatrole`
  - about 35 item-keyed tables for the item-code rename (listed under Z_ChangeStockCode.php below)
- **Out, files:** item images at `part_pics_dir/<StockID>.<png|jpg|jpeg>`.
- **Out, delete:** rows deleted from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`.

## Entry points

### Stocks.php, request start
No permission check and no FormID check are shown.
1. `if GET/POST StockID set -> trim, uppercase to $StockID`, else `$StockID = ''`.
2. `if NextItem -> SELECT stockmaster WHERE stockid > $StockID ORDER ASC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasNext = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
3. `if PreviousItem -> stockid < $StockID ORDER DESC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasPrev = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
4. `if $StockID != '' and UpdateCategories not set -> count stockmaster WHERE stockid=$StockID`. A count of 0 sets `$New = 1`, otherwise `$New = 0`.
5. `if POST New set -> $New = $_POST['New']`.

### Stocks.php, image upload
Runs when `ItemPicture` name is not empty.
- `$ImgExt` comes from the file name. `$FileName = part_pics_dir/StockID.ImgExt`. `$UploadTheFile = 'Yes'` to start.
- `$UploadTheFile = 'No'` (with a warning) for each of these:
  - `ImgExt not in (png, jpg, jpeg)`
  - `size > MaxImageSize*1024`
  - `type == 'text/plain'`
  - `error == 6`
  - `not is_writable(part_pics_dir)`
- Existing `StockID.png`, `StockID.jpg` and `StockID.jpeg` files are unlinked first. If an unlink fails, an error is shown and `$UploadTheFile = 'No'`.
- `if $UploadTheFile == 'Yes' -> move_uploaded_file`. The result message is a link on success, or 'Something is wrong with uploading' on failure.

### Stocks.php, submit validation
Each failure sets `$InputError = 1`, shows an error and records the field in `$Errors`. All checks run (no early exit).
1. `!isset(Description) or len > 50 or len == 0` -> Description.
2. `len(LongDescription) == 0` -> LongDescription.
3. `len(StockID) == 0` -> StockID.
4. `ContainsIllegalCharacters(StockID) or strpos(StockID,' ')` -> StockID, and `$StockID = ''`.
5. `len(Units) > 20` -> Units.
6. `len(BarCode) > 20` -> BarCode.
7. Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight and EOQ: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` or `< 0` -> that field.
8. `Controlled == 0 and Serialised == 1` -> Serialised.
9. `NextSerialNo != 0 and Serialised == 0` -> NextSerialNo.
10. `NextSerialNo != 0 and MBFlag != 'M'` -> NextSerialNo.
11. `MBFlag in (A, K, D, G) and Controlled == 1` -> Controlled.
12. `trim(CategoryID) == ''` -> CategoryID.
13. Pansize and ShrinkFactor: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` -> that field.
- `if Serialised == 1 -> DecimalPlaces = 0`.

### Stocks.php, extra checks when `$New == 0`
The check on `$New` is partly off-screen. The checks below are shown. Each sets `InputError=1`.
- `OldMBFlag != MBFlag and OldMBFlag in [M,B] and MBFlag in [A,K,D,G]` combined with:
  - `StockQtyRow[0] != 0 and OldMBFlag != G` -> refused, stock on hand.
  - `Controlled == 1` -> refused, lot controlled.
- `MBFlag == K` and open sales order lines (`stkcode=StockID AND completed=0` and `quantity-qtyinvoiced != 0`) -> refused.
- `MBFlag in [K,A,D]` and open purchase order lines -> refused. The lines are those with `purchorderdetails.completed=0`, `purchorders.status not in [Cancelled, Completed, Rejected]` and `quantityord-quantityrecd != 0`.
- `OldMBFlag in [M,K,A,G] and MBFlag in [B,D]` and a BOM with `parent=StockID` -> refused.
- `OldMBFlag in [M,B,D,G] and MBFlag in [A,K]` and a BOM with `component=StockID` -> refused.
- `OldControlled != Controlled and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
- `OldSerialised != Serialised and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
- Property loop `i < PropertyCounter`: `PropNumeric[i]==1 and (value < PropMin[i] or value > PropMax[i])` -> refused.

### Stocks.php, update (`$InputError == 0`, existing item)
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. UPDATE `stockmaster` (numeric fields go through `filter_number_format`).
3. `if count(languages) > 0` -> per language, DELETE then INSERT in `stockdescriptiontranslations`.
4. `if OldDescription != Description or OldLongDescription != LongDescription -> UPDATE stockdescriptiontranslations SET needsrevision='0' WHERE stockid`. This applies to all of the item's translations.
5. DELETE `stockitemproperties`, then INSERT per property. `PropType==2` becomes 1 if the value is 'on', otherwise 0. `PropNumeric==1` goes through `filter_number_format`.
6. `if OldStockAccount != NewStockAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)` for the journal number. Two `gltrans` type 0 rows follow: debit `NewStockAct` and credit `OldStockAccount`, amount `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`.
7. `if OldWIPAccount != NewWIPAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> sum open work order WIP (`workorders.closed=0`), per row `costissued - costrecd`. `if WIPValue != 0` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)`, then two type 0 rows: debit `NewWIPAct`, credit `OldWIPAccount`.
8. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.

### Stocks.php, insert (new item)
- `if DB_num_rows(SELECT stockid WHERE stockid=...) == 1 -> InputError=1, Errors[]='StockID'`, with a duplicate-code message.
- Otherwise: `DB_Txn_Begin`, INSERT `stockmaster`.
- `if DB_error_no()==0`:
  - INSERT `stockdescriptiontranslations` per language, only if there are languages.
  - INSERT `stockitemproperties` per property.
  - `INSERT INTO locstock SELECT locations.loccode, StockID FROM locations`.
  - `DB_Txn_Commit`.
  - `if DB_error_no()==0` -> unset the POST fields and set `$New=1`.

### Stocks.php, delete
Runs when `POST delete` is set and `mb_strlen > 1`. `$CancelDelete = 1` with a warning (and a count) if any of these holds:
- `stockmoves` count > 0 for the item.
- `bom` with `component=StockID` > 0.
- `salesorderdetails` with `stkcode` > 0.
- `salesanalysis` > 0.
- `purchorderdetails` with `itemcode` > 0.
- `GetQuantityOnHand(StockID,'ALL') != 0`.
- `offers` count != 0.
- `tenderitems` count != 0.

If `$CancelDelete == 0`:
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. DELETE from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`, in that order.
3. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.
4. Unset the POST fields, `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` and `$StockID`; `$New = 1`.

### Stocks.php, form display
- `if StockID unset/'' or UpdateCategories set` -> blank or new form.
- `elseif UpdateCategories unset and InputError != 1` -> load `stockmaster` and `stockdescriptiontranslations` into the form.
- `else` -> keep the posted values.
- Defaults:
  - EOQ, Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight, Controlled, Pansize, ShrinkFactor, NextSerialNo, DecimalPlaces, Discontinued -> 0.
  - `Serialised` -> 0 if empty or `Controlled == 0`.
  - `Units` -> 'each'.
  - `TaxCat` -> `$_SESSION['DefaultTaxCategory']`.
- `MBFlag` select:
  - Pre-selected only on A (Assembly), D (Service/Labour) and when unset.
  - Kit, Manufactured, Phantom and Purchased are each selected when unset or equal to their own flag. Phantom and Purchased also select on ''.
- `NextSerialNo` is shown only if `Serialised == 1 and MBFlag == 'M'`, otherwise a hidden 0.
- `if ClearImage` -> unlink the png, jpg and jpeg files. `if is_file` still true -> error 'You do not have access to delete this item image file'.
- `if New == 1` -> editable StockID and a `submit` 'Insert New Item' button.
- `if New != 1` -> 'Update' and 'Delete This Item' buttons. Delete has a JS confirm.
- Previous/Next buttons show if `StockID != '' and InputError == 0`.
- Property inputs come from `stockcatproperties WHERE categoryid=CategoryID AND reqatsalesorder=0`. `controltype` 0 is a textbox (numeric gets min/max hidden inputs), 1 is a select (defaultvalue split by comma), 2 is a checkbox. Values come from `stockitemproperties` when `StockID` is set.

### Z_ChangeStockCategory.php (`if isset(ProcessStockChange)`)
Each check below ends the run with an error:
- `old category not in stockcategory` (0 rows).
- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockCategory)`.
- `NewStockCategory == ''`.
- `new category already exists` (rows != 0).

Then:
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. INSERT a copy of the old `stockcategory` row under the new id.
3. UPDATE `stockcatproperties.categoryid`.
4. UPDATE `stockmaster.categoryid`.
5. UPDATE `salesanalysis.stkcategory`.
6. UPDATE `internalstockcatrole.categoryid`.
7. `SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1`.
8. `DB_Txn_Commit`.
9. DELETE the old `stockcategory` row, outside the transaction.

### Z_ChangeStockCode.php
Each check sets `$InputError = 1`:
- `old code not in stockmaster`.
- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockID)`.
- `NewStockID == ''`.
- `new code already exists`.

If `InputError == 0`:
1. `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. INSERT a new `stockmaster` row.
3. `ChangeFieldInTable` over `locstock`, `stockmoves`, `loctransfers`, `mrpdemands`, `mrpplannedorders` (if it exists), `mrprequirements` (if it exists), `mrpsupplies` (if it exists), `salesanalysis`, `orderdeliverydifferenceslog`, `prices`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchdata`, `shipmentcharges`, `stockcheckfreeze`, `stockcounts`, `grns`, `contractbom`, `bom` (component and parent), `stockrequestitems`, `stockdescriptiontranslations`, `custitem`, `pricematrix`, `pickreqdetails`, `stockitemproperties`, `worequirements` (stockid and parentstockid), `woitems`, `salescatprod`, `stockserialitems`, `stockserialmoves`, `offers`, `tenderitems`, `prodspecs`, `qasamples`. The condensation says 24 calls but lists more tables.
4. For each of png, jpg and jpeg: rename the image file, or report 'failed' or 'no image to rename'.
5. `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Commit`.
6. DELETE the old `stockmaster` row.
7. If `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem'] == OldStockID`, set it to `NewStockID`.

## Decisions

## Order and failure
- **Update:** everything is inside one transaction. Errors from `DB_query` are re-raised to the caller. No explicit rollback is shown, and `DB_Txn_Commit` follows the later steps.
- **Insert:** the transaction wraps all inserts. If the `stockmaster` INSERT fails (`DB_error_no != 0`), the remaining inserts are skipped. No explicit rollback is shown.
- **Delete:** the queries are inside a transaction. No check of per-query success before commit is shown.
- **Z_ChangeStockCategory:** the old-category DELETE is outside the transaction, after commit. If it fails, both category rows exist. The message for each step is passed to `DB_query` (with the transaction flag `true`).
- **Z_ChangeStockCode:** the old `stockmaster` row is deleted after commit. A failed `ChangeFieldInTable` or image rename is not handled; the rename is only reported in the output.
- **GetNextTransNo:** it runs `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1`, then re-SELECTs `typeno` and returns it. Failures show a 'CRITICAL ERROR' message through `DB_query`. The row lock is held until the surrounding transaction ends, so the number is serialised only inside a transaction. In Stocks.php it is called inside the update transaction, after `DB_Txn_Begin`.
- No loops poll or retry.

## Connections
- **`GetNextTransNo(0)`** (`webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`): called by Stocks.php for the stock and WIP cost journals. Type 0 is the journal type. It reads and increments `systypes.typeno` for `typeid=0` and returns the new value, which Stocks.php uses as `typeno` in `gltrans`.
- **`GetQuantityOnHand($StockID,'ALL')`** (behaviour not in this topic): used by the delete guard.
- **Helper functions** (behaviour not in this topic): `ContainsIllegalCharacters`, `filter_number_format`, `locale_number_format`, `GetImageLink`, `ChangeFieldInTable`, `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`.
- **Shared tables:** `stockmaster`, `stockcategory`, `stockcatproperties`, `locstock`, `locations`, `gltrans`, `systypes`, `workorders`, `woitems`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchorders`, `bom` and the other tables named above.
- **Session:** `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` is shared with the other stock pages. It is unset on delete and updated on code rename.

## Conclusions
- Stocks.php posts the stock journal using `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`. This only happens if the stock account changed with `gllink_stock == 1`. `gltrans` rows are not checked against the GL accounts and no balance check is made, but the two rows carry the same amount in opposite directions.
- Changing a category's stock accounts does not itself post journals here. Only item-level account changes do. The category-change path appears to set the accounts through `UpdateCategories` and the form. The same item-level journals are posted from `$OldStockAccount != $NewStockAct`.
- Z_ChangeStockCategory moves only `stockcatproperties`, `stockmaster`, `salesanalysis` and `internalstockcatrole`. It leaves other tables that refer to the category alone. Other parts keeping their own copy of the category code will keep the old one.
- Z_ChangeStockCode has no duplicate guard beyond the form check. Submitting the same rename twice fails the second time, since the old code no longer exists.
- Image-name checks in Stocks.php do not need to match real content. Only the extension, size and the 'text/plain' type are tested.
- The delete guard does not look at `custitem`, `stockserialitems`, `worequirements`, `woitems` and the other tables Z_ChangeStockCode updates, so a delete could succeed with rows still pointing at the item. Whether the database refuses depends on its foreign keys (not shown here).
- A repeated insert of the same code is refused by the duplicate check, so the item is not created twice.

## Hazards
- Category rename: the old category row is deleted outside the transaction.
- Item-code rename: if the transaction commit succeeds and the old-row DELETE fails, both items exist. If an image rename fails, the image is lost from the new code.
- No explicit rollback for any failed transaction step.
- No permission checks on any of the three scripts.
- GL journal accounts and balance are unchecked.
- `GetNextTransNo` only serialises concurrent callers when the call is inside a transaction.
- `ChangeFieldInTable` failures are unhandled, so a partial rename is possible.
- The `needsrevision='0'` update runs for all translations of the item when the description changed, even if translation text was just rewritten.

Item notes are in place, but I haven't run or tested any of it. There was nothing to run against, so please try it on a test database before relying on it.

**What was added**
- **Storage:** a new `stockitemnotes` table, created by `sql/updates/44.php`. Each note has an id, the item code, the text, the user who added it and when. The same upgrade registers the new page in the `scripts` table at security level 11, the same as `StockClone.php`.
- **Notes page:** a new `StockNotes.php` page lists an item's notes (date, user, text). From there you can add a note, edit one (via the Edit link, then Update Note) or delete one (with a confirmation prompt).
- **Reaching it:** `SelectProduct.php` now shows a "Maintain Item Notes" link in the item's maintenance options, next to "Modify Item Details".
- **Import:** `Z_ImportStocks.php` accepts an optional 19th CSV column, `Notes`. The existing 18-column files still import as before. Several notes for one item go in the one cell, separated by `|`. Notes are inserted in the same transaction as the item, so a failed row rolls them back too. The downloadable template now shows the `Notes` column.
- **Delete and rename:** deleting an item in `Stocks.php` now also deletes its notes. `Z_ChangeStockCode.php` now carries the notes over to the new code when an item is renamed.

**Things to check**
- I did not add `stockitemnotes.sql` to `install/sql/tables`. The installer builds the base tables and then runs the numbered updates, which is where `stockmaster.stockid` is widened to 64 characters. A table created from the install folder would have used the old 20-character size. If you'd rather have it in the installer too, it needs a 64-character `stockid`.
- I did not touch `install/sql/data/scripts.sql`. The page is registered by the upgrade instead.
- The part-code import (`Z_ImportPartCodes.php`, which goes through `InsertStockItem`) doesn't take notes. Only the stock item import does.
- The delimiter is `|`, so a note that itself contains a `|` will be split into two notes on import.
